basic.description:
{Basic Gift}

After each attack, the Jester blows out the candles: a small blast of damage hits the victim and its neighbours. No one may refuse a present.

advanced.description:
{Advanced Gift}

The party never stops: after every strike, the Jester detonates a birthday cake that even fire- and magic-immune creatures are compelled to accept.

expert.description:
{Expert Gift}

A gift for everyone: the blast spares nobody standing near the victim, ignoring every spell immunity. Candles included.
